user_query: Attention all music lovers! I'm hosting a virtual concert and I need some popular tracks to entertain the audience. Can you recommend a playlist on Soundcloud that features songs from the Bolivia Songs chart? Additionally, fetch the details of a track from the Singapore Songs chart and provide me with the lyrics to engage the audience.

TaskList.description: Retrieve the top songs from the Bolivia Songs chart to recommend a playlist on Soundcloud.
Fetch details of a specific track from the Singapore Songs chart.
Obtain the lyrics of the selected track to engage the audience.
